notes: Secondary market prices are indicative algorithmic estimates from Notice.co combining private secondary trades, tender offers, and reference data. They are not fund marks, guaranteed bids, or ASC 820 fair values.

openai.name: OpenAI

fluidstack.name: Fluidstack

boom.name: Boom
boom.caveat: Cliff drop in early 2026 is likely a share-basis break (recap, split, or different share class series), not a true 97% valuation loss.

chime.name: Chime
chime.note: Fintech digital banking; net flat over 2 years

discord.name: Discord
discord.note: Communication platform; spiked briefly in early 2026 before normalizing

klarna.name: Klarna
klarna.note: BNPL fintech; protracted secondary downtrend following initial IPO speculation

stripe.name: Stripe
stripe.note: Global online payments and financial infrastructure platform; price doubled over 2Y and has plateaued near $65-70 since spring 2026.

figure.name: Figure AI
figure.note: Humanoid robotics developer; trades ~26% below its 2025 peak of ~$204.
figure.caveat: Chart is a step function: price sat at ~$13-17 until a single-day +1,021% re-mark on 2025-03-21 (to ~$150), so the 2Y change is dominated by one re-pricing, not gradual trade-driven appreciation. Note notice.co/c/figure is a different company (Figure Technology Solutions); Figure AI is notice.co/c/figure-ai.

canva.name: Canva
canva.note: Online design and visual communication platform; uptrend with a ~19% pullback from its 2026 high.

epic-games.name: Epic Games
epic-games.note: Fortnite maker and Unreal Engine owner; range-bound with a gentle downtrend, now near its 2Y low.

kraken.name: Kraken
kraken.note: Crypto exchange; price doubled over 2Y but has given back roughly 40% from its early-2026 plateau (~$45).
kraken.caveat: Chart is very noisy mid-2025 to early 2026 (21 daily moves >20%, plus a one-day print near $61); treat peak values as unreliable thin-market prints.

ramp.name: Ramp
ramp.note: Corporate card and spend-management fintech; staircase of step-ups with each round, now ~12% off its ~$151 high.

kalshi.name: Kalshi
kalshi.note: CFTC-regulated prediction-market exchange; Notice cites estimated revenue of ~$735M in 2025 vs ~$25M in 2024.
kalshi.caveat: Price moves in discrete steps (e.g. +304% on 2025-11-06) and has a brief outlier spike to ~$1,074; impliedValuation is the last-round valuation because Notice cannot compute a market cap.

whoop.name: Whoop
whoop.note: Wearable health and fitness tracking subscription company; has faded ~30% from its April 2026 re-mark high (~$11.46).
whoop.caveat: Price was flat at ~$1.1-1.6 for 18 months, then a single-day +880% re-mark on 2026-04-01 (to ~$11); the 2Y change is almost entirely that one step.

axiom-space.name: Axiom Space
axiom-space.note: Commercial space station and private astronaut mission company; steady decline, ~60% below its ~$212 high.
axiom-space.caveat: impliedValuation is the last-round valuation because Notice cannot compute a market cap (the $1.00B figure does not reflect the current price).

motive-technologies.name: Motive Technologies
motive-technologies.note: Fleet management, telematics and AI dashcam platform for trucking and logistics (formerly KeepTruckin); Notice slug is /c/keeptruckin.

vast-data.name: Vast Data
vast-data.note: AI data platform and storage software vendor; flat ~$20 through 2025, then re-rated in January 2026.
vast-data.caveat: impliedValuation is the last-round valuation because Notice cannot compute a market cap; includes a +148% one-day step on 2026-01-09.

cerebras.name: Cerebras
cerebras.note: Wafer-scale AI chip maker; now publicly traded after its 2026 IPO and ~46% below its post-IPO high (~$311).
cerebras.caveat: Company has IPO'd (Notice shows an IPO marker); the chart splices pre-IPO secondary prices with public-market trading, so it is no longer a pure private secondary series. Notice slug is /c/cerebras-net.

apptronik.name: Apptronik
apptronik.note: Humanoid robot developer (Apollo); stepped up in stages through 2025 and has been flat-to-lower in 2026.
apptronik.caveat: Flat at ~$1.3 until a single-day +868% step on 2025-02-28, plus a +61% step on 2025-09-02; most of the 2Y change comes from these round re-marks.

anduril.name: Anduril
anduril.note: Defense technology company building autonomous systems and AI-enabled weapons platforms; one of the steadiest climbers in the set.
anduril.caveat: Two transient down-prints (~$30 and ~$60) around late June to July 2026 look like bad data points, not real drawdowns.

neuralink.name: Neuralink
neuralink.note: Brain-computer interface developer; grew slowly through 2025, then re-rated sharply in 2026 with volatile marks (peak ~$315).
neuralink.caveat: Several 2026 one-day swings of +50% to +127% and two brief dips to ~$170 look like mark/print noise.

groq.name: Groq
groq.note: AI inference chip and cloud provider; doubled over 2Y but ~26% below its 2026 peak (~$49.6).
groq.caveat: impliedValuation is the last-round valuation because Notice cannot compute a market cap.

perplexity.name: Perplexity
perplexity.note: AI-powered answer and search engine; stepped up through 2025, now ~19% below its ~$73.6 peak. Notice slug is /c/perplexity-ai.
perplexity.caveat: Early-window glitch: a ~3-day dip to ~$3 in Nov 2024 followed by a +800% single-day recovery on 2024-12-12 (to ~$33); the earliest data points are unreliable.

lambda.name: Lambda
lambda.note: GPU cloud and AI compute provider; drifted lower through mid-2025, then roughly tripled off the trough. Notice slug is /c/lambdalabs.

mercor.name: Mercor
mercor.note: AI-powered talent marketplace supplying expert contractors for AI model training and evaluation; ~14% below its ~$975 high.
mercor.caveat: Chart is two large steps (+632% on 2025-02-20 and +419% on 2025-10-10) separated by flat stretches, so the 2Y change reflects round re-marks rather than continuous trading.

colossal.name: Colossal Biosciences
colossal.note: De-extinction and genetic-engineering biotech; price has faded ~40% from its January 2025 re-mark high (~$26). Notice shows it as 'Colossal Bio' at /c/colossal.
colossal.caveat: Flat at ~$3 until a single-day +753% step on 2025-01-15; the entire 2Y gain comes from that step. impliedValuation is the last-round valuation because Notice cannot compute a market cap.

airwallex.name: Airwallex
airwallex.note: Cross-border payments and global financial platform for businesses; two round-driven step-ups (May 2025, Jan 2026) with a recent ~14% pullback.

dataminr.name: Dataminr
dataminr.note: Real-time AI event and risk detection platform; ~25% below its early-2025 high (~$12.2), with a partial rebound off the early-2026 low.

coreweave.name: CoreWeave
coreweave.note: Specialized GPU cloud provider for AI training, inference and rendering workloads.

plaid.name: Plaid

zipline.name: Zipline

oura.name: Oura

crusoe.name: Crusoe

deel.name: Deel

replit.name: Replit

ripple.name: Ripple

relativity-space.name: Relativity Space

vanta.name: Vanta

checkr.name: Checkr

masterclass.name: MasterClass

lime.name: Lime

intercom.name: Intercom
